Welcome to this journey, where we dive into the fascinating world of decision-making under uncertainty.
Have you ever found yourself wishing for just a little more information before making a tough call? Or wondered why sometimes, even with your best effort, things just don’t turn out as planned?
The truth is, life rarely hands us all the answers. Most of the time, we’re making choices in the dark, juggling between what we know and what we can only guess.
Here’s where Annie Duke’s book, Thinking in Bets: Making Smarter Decisions When You Don't Have All the Facts, comes in. She invites us to see every decision—big or small—through the eyes of a professional poker player, where skill and luck dance together and uncertainty is simply part of the game.
Together, we're going to discover how shifting our focus from the outcome to the actual process behind our choices can change everything.
Imagine learning how to separate what you can control from what you can’t, how to spot those tricky thinking traps we all fall into, and how to become more comfortable with the unknown.
Along the way, Annie Duke’s insights will help us build habits that value growth, feedback, and adaptability—so we’re not just making decisions, but making smarter ones, time and again.
So, let’s explore together how thinking in bets can shape the way we face uncertainty—and help us all make choices with a little more confidence, no matter what life deals us.
